subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Important
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Important"** means something that is of **great significance or value.** (महत्वपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **Attending the meeting is important for understanding the project's progress.
 
 
 
• **"Trivial"** refers to something that is of** little value or importance. **(तुच्छ)
 
 
• **Example: **He often spends time on trivial details rather than focusing on the main issue.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Important'** is **'Trivial'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Productive** (उत्पादक): Yielding good results or benefits.

 
 
• **Example:** The** productive** meeting resulted in several new initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Significant** (महत्वपूर्ण): Sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention.
 
 
• **Example: **Her **significant** contributions to the project were recognized by the team.
 
 
 
• **Recurring** (बार-बार होने वाला): Occurring repeatedly or periodically.
 
 
• **Example:** The **recurring** issues with the software need to be addressed immediately.
 
 

50:Tb9d,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
